newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-March aluminium output up 26.9 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-March aluminium output up 26.9 pct yr/yr.

text.p: China's output of aluminium totalled 452,900 tonnes in January-March, a 26.9 percent climb compared with the same 1996 period, the Shanghai Securities News said on Friday quoting figures from the State Statistical Bureau.
Aluminium production in March alone was 157,900 tonnes, up 4.2 percent from the adjusted figure for February, the figures showed.

Aluminium oxide production in March totalled 263,600 tonnes, up 68.2 percent on February, the figures showed. The total for January-March was 718,800 tonnes, down 33.2 percent compared with the year-ago period.

Aluminium products output in March totalled 124,500 tonnes, up 22.7 percent on February. The first quarter total was 299,200 tonnes, up 1.8 percent compared with January-March 1996, the figures showed.
